title: Elf Bar 600 Strawberry Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Designed for use with the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pods provide a seamless way to enjoy outstanding flavour and satisfaction without the waste and expense caused by single-use disposables. Each 2ml prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on personal usage, and contains 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth, satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw and rapid nicotine relief. Strawberry Ice Flavour: A bright and juicy strawberry flavour layered with a crisp menthol exhale. The natural sweetness of ripe strawberries is balanced by the cool, refreshing sensation of ice, making for a smooth and uplifting vape. Swapping pods is quick and hassle-free—just click a fresh one into place and vape. Whether you're switching from disposables or looking for a convenient way to enjoy your favourite Elf Bar flavours, these prefilled pods deliver exceptional taste in a practical, replaceable format.
